title: Unisex Gamer – Five More Minutes. (It's 3 A.M.) Hoodie

seo.title: Gamer Hoodie – Five More Minutes. (It's 3 A.M.)
seo.description: A funny gamer hoodie for late nights: FIVE MORE MINUTES. (IT'S 3 A.M.) Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

FIVE MORE MINUTES. (IT'S 3 A.M.) is the gamer hoodie for the player who has been about to stop for hours, worn on late nights, the couch and as a gift from a parent or partner who gave up on bedtime.

FIVE MORE MINUTES. runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and (IT'S 3 A.M.) fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a gamer in a purple hoodie and headset sits slumped at a trestle desk with wide, tired eyes and a controller in both hands, a glowing monitor, three plain soda cans and a pizza crust beside the keyboard and a cat asleep on the desk corner.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the desk scene; Sand gets dark purple and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a late night session?
Yes. The Five More Minutes. (It's 3 A.M.) hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for long evenings at the desk, the couch and cool rooms with a console running.

How does the Five More Minutes. (It's 3 A.M.) hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a gamer?
It is a natural one. Every gamer has said five more minutes at 3 a.m., so it lands with friends, parents and partners who have heard the line before. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the gamer sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Five More Minutes. (It's 3 A.M.) hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
